title: Appointment Scheduling Standards Schedule: Booking Horizon, Lead Time, Slot Length and Booking Channels
content:
Riverbend Regional Health's Patient Access Center books seven visit types under **Appointment Scheduling**. Each visit type has its own booking horizon, minimum lead time, slot length, booking channels and figure for future appointments one patient may hold in the department.

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Booking horizon** — the number of calendar days ahead within which an appointment may be booked.
- **Minimum lead time** — the number of hours between booking and the scheduled start below which the slot cannot be booked.
- **Slot length** — the scheduled length of the slot, in minutes.
- **Booking channels** — the channels through which the visit type is booked.
- **Portal self-scheduling** — whether the patient may book the visit type through the patient portal.
- **Future appointments per department** — the number of future appointments a patient may hold in one department.

## Schedule by visit type

| Visit type | Booking horizon (calendar days ahead) | Minimum lead time (hours) | Slot length (minutes) | Booking channels | Portal self-scheduling | Future appointments per department |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | 90 | 2 | 20 | patient portal, call center, in clinic | allowed | 2 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | 30 | 1 | 15 | patient portal, call center | allowed | 2 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | 180 | 24 | 60 | call center, referral queue | not allowed | 2 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | 60 | 24 | 45 | call center, referral queue | not allowed | 3 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | 90 | 48 | 120 | call center, in clinic | not allowed | 30 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | 30 | 24 | 45 | call center, referral queue | not allowed | 2 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | 120 | 72 | 90 | call center, referral queue | not allowed | 2 |

## Notes on the schedule

- Only the Primary Care Office Visit and the Telehealth Video Visit allow portal self-scheduling, and the patient portal appears among the booking channels of those two visit types only.
- The Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment carries the largest figure for future appointments per department (30); the Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) carries 3; every other visit type carries 2.
- Minimum lead time runs from 1 hour (Telehealth Video Visit) to 72 hours (Outpatient Procedure Appointment).

## Reading the schedule — hypothetical illustrations

These illustrations use invented requests to show how the figures read; they are not customer facts.

- *Hypothetical:* a Specialty New-Patient Consultation slot 150 calendar days ahead lies inside that visit type's 180-day horizon; the same distance would lie outside the 120-day horizon of an Outpatient Procedure Appointment.
- *Hypothetical:* a Telehealth Video Visit slot starting 3 hours after the moment of booking meets that visit type's 1-hour minimum lead time; a Pre-Admission Testing Appointment slot starting 3 hours away does not meet its 24-hour minimum lead time.
- *Hypothetical:* a request to book a Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) through the patient portal falls outside both its booking channels (call center, referral queue) and its portal self-scheduling setting (not allowed).
